internal_discovery.plain_explanation: All three haja occurrences name a purpose or need: Jacob's inward concern, practical aims carried by livestock, and needs held in breasts. The referent varies while requirement-directedness remains.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Possessors and prepositional phrases locate the need in a self, breast, or practical activity; the root supplies the required/sought purpose.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 12:68 can be read as a private wish rather than objective necessity, so the core must include sought purpose, not strict necessity.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The root means desire only; practical needs in 40:80 and 59:9 require a lack/requirement dimension.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinct from appetite, which pulls toward an object, and from intention, which plans action; Hwj profiles a lack-linked requirement or purpose.
internal_discovery.rationale: All uses cohere, but three noun-only occurrences constrain abstraction and strength.
